properties.description:
MVP SCOPE CLARIFICATION: one human plus one replying agent, using the existing Pi agent loop. Multi-human/multi-agent participation and configurable activation policies are future direction, not current MVP completion criteria. Preserve compatible participant ownership/UX without implementing future orchestration now. Pi 0.84.2 installed locally supports steer() and followUp(); steering waits until the current assistant turn/tool calls finish, follow-up waits until pending work ends. Broccoli already exposes /api/steer. Source inspection, not a live steering test.

Chat needs human, multi-human, multi-agent and mixed sessions, plus long-lived General/Feedback/Bug reports channels within the build space. View toolbar stays one row: view selector, compact +, adjacent session selector with New count, icon-only Context, expandable search, participant avatars and add participant. Each agent owns model/effort, optional role/system instructions and every-message or ping-only activation; effort is a dropdown. Stop targets an agent, not shared composer. Composer is shared messaging with inline attachments/references, no global model/Stop. Message avatar fits author/timestamp header; content spans full width without background panels. Shared ScrollArea needs double-up/down at scrollbar ends; remove large Jump to latest. Search rests as icon, expands input, has generic placeholder, and uses same component across views. Preserve accepted board two-row cards, avatar on second row, no excess padding. Turn/tool/timing presentation remains for a dedicated revision. Exact text/exchange selections, annotations, long-history ergonomics/performance and measured timing remain requirements. Busy-agent response to a new participant correction/request is still under analysis. Full 26-comment mapping is in local mvp-ui-concepts/chat-round-1/review.md.
properties.title: Shared channels and participant-owned agent controls
